description: Money formatting and math with CLDR data (ICU 78 / CLDR 48, matches Intl.NumberFormat): format an amount for any of 60 locales and 154 active ISO 4217 currencies (symbol, narrow symbol or code; standard or accounting negatives; Indian lakh grouping, Swiss apostrophes, RTL marks), round with 9 modes or cash rounding (CHF 0.05), parse a formatted string such as "1.234,56 €" or "(US$1,234.50)" back to an exact amount and currency, split an amount by ratios without losing a cent (largest remainder) and look up currency or country info (digits, symbols, cash rounding, countries). Exact decimal arithmetic, no floats. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/currency-format

country.description: ISO 3166 country: use its currency (info: list it)

currency.description: ISO 4217 code (default: the locale's country currency)

locale.description: en-US, de-DE, fr-CH, ja-JP, hi-IN ... or just a language
